shell.title: Training requests
shell.description: Manage automated round settings, training request templates, and applicant tracking — fully separate from real orders.

templates.title: Training request templates
templates.description: Reusable templates for training pool requests. Each template can generate bidding or fixed-price training orders.

templateWizard.filesSkipHelp: Attachments are not stored with training requests yet; you can skip this step.
templateWizard.reviewNote: This training request will be saved only — no real marketplace order is created.
templateWizard.projectTypeHelpFixed: Fixed price: a single budget and duration used as the training request model.
templateWizard.projectTypeHelpBidding: Bidding: a budget range and duration range used when generating the training request.
templateWizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the order clearly and in detail
templateWizard.budgetFixedHelp: Enter a whole-number budget within an approved span (e.g. 20–1000 JOD).
templateWizard.budgetBiddingHelp: Enter an approved budget range (e.g. 50–100 or 100–150 JOD). Close values are adjusted automatically.
templateWizard.filesInfoBody: Attachments are not saved with training requests yet. Continue to review to save the order.

errors.title: Order title is required.
errors.description: Order description is required (at least 10 characters).
errors.budget: Please enter a valid budget greater than 0.
errors.budgetInteger: Budget must be a whole number without decimals.
errors.budgetFixedRange: Budget must fall within an approved span (e.g. 20–1000 JOD).
errors.bidBudgetMaxOrder: Maximum must be greater than or equal to minimum.
errors.durationMin: Please enter a valid minimum duration greater than 0.
errors.durationMax: Please enter a valid maximum duration greater than 0.
errors.durationMaxOrder: Maximum duration must be greater than or equal to minimum.
errors.durationValue: Please enter a valid duration greater than 0.
errors.stepMultiple: Please complete all required fields in this step.
errors.stepIncomplete: Complete the required fields in this step to continue.

toast.validationMessage: Please complete the required data correctly.

rounds.title: Training request rounds
rounds.description: Only one active training round at a time. Starting a new round ends the previous one and removes its requests from the marketplace immediately, while history remains here for review.

applications.title: Training request applicants
applications.description: Applicants on training pool requests, grouped by training order.
